_about: Each CSV is a series of ~1-minute recordings (~600 rows at ~10 Hz) separated by time gaps. 'phases' gives one letter per recording in order: D = sample (data), A = indoor lab air. null = layout not yet confirmed (file is kept out of training). rosin_pct is the rosin share of the rosin/salak mixture (salak = 100 - rosin_pct).

data-rosin-air-to3.30-3.45.csv.notes: Rosin vs lab air. Air recordings at ~3:32, 3:38:12, 3:44:36; rosin at start, 3:35, 3:41:26.

data-rosin+salak(50%-50%).csv.notes: Alternating data/air; one data+air pair is one cycle.

data-rosin-100%-pure.csv.notes: First 5 rosin, then air, rosin again from 7:17 PM (recording starting 19:16:36).

data-rosin(80%)+salak(20%)+1blank-contai.notes: 11 recordings incl. 1 blank container; data/air layout not yet given.
